entities.name: Anissa Rawda Najjar
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Anissa Rawda Najjar was a Lebanese feminist and women's rights activist. She was a co-founder and longtime leader of the Village Welfare Society. As well, she introduced the Lebanon Chapter of CISV.
